title: fix(plugin-dashboard,app-shell): Refresh All shares the filter bar's row, and a report card follows its content (objectui#11694)
body:
Part of #11694. This PR covers every case the claim's fence allows. One case stays open pending a placement decision, described under "Open question" below: a console dashboard with no filter bar, where the only header is the console page's own.
Clause-②: no

## What changes

- **"Refresh All" shares a row instead of taking one** (`DashboardRenderer`). The refresh control and its record-count badge sit in the first of these rows that exists: the filter bar's row, right-aligned; the renderer's own header row, when there is no filter bar and the renderer draws a header; otherwise a row of its own, only as tall as the button. When the filters do not fit beside it (phone width), the control wraps below them, right-aligned.
- **The full-width rows above the widgets are content-sized** (`DashboardRenderer`). In the positioned grid (a dashboard that declares `columns`, or whose widget layout is wider than 4), every implicit row carries `minmax(5rem, auto)`, the floor chart widgets need. The header and toolbar rows are now explicit `auto` tracks (`grid-rows-[auto]` or `grid-rows-[auto_auto]`, counted by `leadingRows`), so the floor stays on widget rows only. Widgets are auto-placed by span alone, so the leading items always take the first rows.
- **A report's card follows its content** (`ReportView`). The bordered card loses `min-h-150` (37.5rem).

No export, prop, type member or i18n key is added: the control moved between existing rows, and `DashboardFilterBar` receives only a `className` (`min-w-0 grow`) through its existing prop.

## Mechanism, measured (corrections to the dispatch hypotheses)

- H1 holds, with one correction. The two render sites are the mobile flex body and the desktop grid. Both rendered `filterBar` and then `refreshButton` as siblings, and the filter bar is itself a `col-span-full` grid item (`DashboardFilterBar`'s own root). The band was therefore two 5rem rows, not one. The filter bar's row also got the floor: its 32px controls were stretched to a 72px item plus `mb-2`.
- H2: the console mount (`DashboardView`) passes `hideHeaderText`, so the renderer draws no header there. The page header is the host's own, and the renderer cannot reach it without a new seam (see "Open question"). Embedded mounts (`DashboardWithConfig`, page embeds) draw the renderer's header when `header` is declared, and the control joins that row (the same placement `DashboardGridLayout` already uses).
- H3 holds, and nothing inside the card relied on the minimum. The loading and not-found states return before the card is drawn. The Suspense fallback and `DatasetReportRenderer`'s fetch states size to their text. The embedded chart has a fixed default plot height (280), and tables cap at `max-h-[70vh]`.

## Real-layout reading, before and after (1440x900, Chromium)

The harness was a dev-only page served by the console's own Vite dev server (`apps/console`, workspace source aliases, the console's real `index.css` and `register-plugins`). It mounts the real `DashboardView` and `ReportView` from app-shell inside a frame that reproduces `AppShell`: a 56px `h-14` top bar, a 16rem sidebar and a padding-free main. Metadata reaches the views through `MetadataCtx`, and a stub `queryDataset` returns three to six rows per dimension. The dashboard and report definitions were copied verbatim from objectstack `examples/app-showcase` (`showcase_ops_dashboard`, `showcase_chart_gallery`, `showcase_hours_by_status`, `showcase_status_priority_matrix`) at objectstack `1bc6ca1d`. The harness was never committed. Not reproduced: the real AppHeader and sidebar contents (only their sizes), and real data volumes. Chart card height is content-driven, 457px here. Figures are viewport y-coordinates in px. "Before" is base `267b539`. "After" is `fd0ac51`, and the toolbar figures were re-read after the `grow` change in `56995c1`.

| Delivery Operations (filter bar) | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| filter bar row | 185 to 257 | 185 to 221, Refresh at its right end |
| Refresh row of its own | 281 to 353 | none |
| KPI row (first widget row) | 377 to 553 | 237 to 413 |
| first chart row | 569 to **1026**, below the fold | 429 to **886**, on screen |

| Chart Gallery (no filter bar, console chrome) | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| Refresh row | 185 to 257 | 185 to 221 (button-high) |
| KPI row | 281 to 457 | 237 to 413 |
| first chart row | 473 to **930**, below the fold | 429 to **886**, on screen |

| Reports (summary and matrix, 5 rows each) | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| card height | 600 | 205 |
| empty space below the content | 396 | 1 (the border) |

At 390x844 (after): the two filters stay on one line (169 to 201), Refresh wraps below them, right-aligned (209 to 245), and nothing overflows horizontally (document scroll width 390).

The triage pin, "the first screen of the measured dashboard shows its first widget row without scrolling at 1440x900", holds on both dashboards. The KPI row was on screen before too, and the first row of charts (the row the card measured below the fold) is now on screen as well.

## Tests

- `DashboardRenderer.refreshRow-11694.test.tsx` (plugin-dashboard) pins the mechanism by rendering. With a filter bar, the control and its record count share the filter bar's grid item, and there is no second full-width item. With no filter bar and a drawn header, the control joins the header's item. With both, it prefers the filter bar row. Under the console chrome with no filters, it stands alone. The positioned grid declares exactly `grid-rows-[auto]` or `grid-rows-[auto_auto]`. No auto track is declared when nothing sits above the widgets, or in the responsive grid.
- `ReportView.cardHeight-11694.test.tsx` (app-shell) walks from the report body up to the scroll region. It asserts that no wrapper declares a `min-h-*` and that the bordered card is among the wrappers walked (non-vacuity).
- Reverse verification: the fix and the pins were committed, then the two source files were checked out from base `267b539` with a trap restoring `HEAD`. On disk, `grid-rows-[auto]` went from 1 to 0 in `DashboardRenderer.tsx`. The `ReportView` failure diff shows the received class string ending `overflow-hidden min-h-150`, so the mutation was the tree under test. Result: `Tests 5 failed | 1 passed (6)`. The passing one is the no-auto-track negative control, green in both directions by design. Restore was proven by blob equality with `HEAD` for both files and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Gates (final head `56995c1`)

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' --concurrency=2`: exit 0, `Tasks: 12 successful, 12 total`. Then `--filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`: exit 0, `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check`: exit 0 (script echoed; covers `tsconfig.test.json`, which includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 (re-run after the last test edit).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard test`: exit 0, `Test Files 173 passed (173)`, `Tests 1704 passed | 6 skipped (1710)`, on `56995c1`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, in four `--shard` runs: each exit 0, 1034 files in all (1033 passed, 1 skipped). This ran on `fea4eb0`. Commits after it touched the changeset, the new pin's types, and the filter bar's class string. On `56995c1` the 14 app-shell files naming `ReportView` or `DashboardView` were re-run: exit 0, `Test Files 14 passed (14)`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`: each exit 0, with these verdict lines: `check-control-bytes: OK`; `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`; `No pending changeset names a file this change touches.`; `No test source names a pending changeset.`
- Added by the diff: `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:test-path-roots`, all exit 0 with an OK line. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, `4 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`. `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the five paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.
- Lint, narrowed to the four touched source and test files and run the way each package's `lint` script runs (`eslint` from the package directory, root flat config): 0 errors. The eslint config enables no type-aware linting, and no custom rule reads another file, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The remaining warnings are on untouched lines (pre-existing `no-explicit-any` and others). The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Open question: the console dashboard with no filter bar

On a console dashboard with no filter bar (Chart Gallery), the only header is `DashboardView`'s page header, whose right side is empty. The renderer cannot place the control there without a new seam, which `Clause-②: no` fences out. So the control keeps a row of its own there, now button-high: 36px plus the gap, down from a 5rem row plus the gap. The first chart row is on screen at 1440x900. Options, with the four-axis analysis, are in the dev report on the card. Briefly: A, accept this; B, add a host placement seam (a prop, or an exported hook so `DashboardView` draws the control in its header); C, let the renderer draw the console's header. The recommendation is A. If A is accepted, this PR completes the card.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- The record-count badge's word "records" is a literal English string in `DashboardRenderer` (pre-existing; this PR moves the badge, not its text). Read-only observation, no measurement taken.
- `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` ships no stylesheet of its own, so its utilities, the new `grid-rows-[auto]` and `grid-rows-[auto_auto]` among them, reach a published consumer only through that host's own Tailwind scan. The console scans `packages/plugin-dashboard/src` in its `index.css`. Pre-existing, the plugin-stylesheet family that `scripts/build-plugin-stylesheet.mjs` describes.
